findings.summary: Day directory reconstruction is wrong: api_capture_one computes `day[:4]` (year) and uses capture_id.split("_")[0] as the second path segment, which mismatches the actual layout `YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD_/`. The result is 404 even when files exist.
Same bug repeated in api_capture_file. Both endpoints cannot serve real captures today.
Trash import — `import json  # noqa` is placed mid-module instead of at top. Move to the top of file.
action_open_captures_folder swallows exception but does not log; if the path is wrong there is no feedback for the user.

The HTML does not actually exist yet — README and earlier turns reference it but the file may be a stub. Verify it implements chat, captures tree, distance slider, and provider onboarding per Phase 1 spec.
